input.brief: YF Reformas, reformas integrales de viviendas en Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Islas Canarias

direction.name: The place carries it
direction.idea: For a place, the photograph is the argument. One full-bleed image of where you would be standing fills the first screen, and the design steps back: the name sits along the bottom edge like a film title, or small in a corner, and nothing else interrupts the view. The page that follows keeps that restraint: few words, large pictures, long pauses. The designer's work here is editing: choosing the one frame that makes someone want to be there, and then not covering it.
direction.composition: First screen: a single photograph at 100vw by 100svh, focal point kept clear of text. The name is set either very large (14–20vw) hugging the bottom edge with 16–24px of margin, or small (20–28px) top-left with a one-line description bottom-left. Navigation is two to four words in the top corners in the same small size. If text sits on the image, a soft neutral scrim under the text area only. Below, sections alternate between a short centred or left-set paragraph in a narrow column (max 52ch) with wide empty margins, and photographs shown large: one full-bleed, then a pair at different sizes, then one portrait offset to the right. Practical information (hours, address, rates, booking) is gathered once near the end in a plain two-column block.
direction.typography: A face with some grace for the name; small, calm, well-spaced text everywhere else. Sentence case. Body 17–19px with leading around 1.55.
direction.colour: Neutral paper or deep neutral ground chosen to flatter the photographs; text ink drawn from the darkest tone in the imagery. Colour lives in the pictures.
direction.imagery: The dealt set is the palette. Choose four to six photographs with the same light. The hero image must have a calm area for the name. Full-bleed or large with square corners; never thumbnails, never a carousel of ten.
direction.photoTreatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.
direction.richness: The photographs, at full size, uninterrupted. Empty paper around short text makes the next image land harder.
direction.pitfalls: A weak hero photograph cannot be fixed by typography; pick again. Do not stack a headline, a paragraph and two buttons on the image. Do not use a booking bar that covers the bottom of the view; one small action is enough.

hero.name: Swatch column beside the view
hero.blueprint: A 10px frame of paper colour surrounds the screen. Columns 1–10 are one photograph panel, full height inside the frame, corners radiused 12px, `object-fit: cover`: a wide, calm view with a low horizon and a great deal of sky. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third on two lines of light-weight serif at clamp(72px, 8.6vw, 132px), white, with a neutral scrim behind that band only if the sky is pale. The wordmark sits top-left inside the panel, 28px in. The single action, a white rectangular button, sits bottom-centre, 36px above the panel's lower edge; one supporting sentence at 18px sits bottom-left on columns 1–4, level with it. Columns 11–12 are both the navigation and a preview of the page: a full-height stack of five flat colour blocks of equal height, butted together with no gaps, each holding one text link at 16px in its top-left corner with 20px padding. The five colours are sampled from the photograph, ordered light to dark, and each is the ground colour of the section its link scrolls to. There is no other navigation.
hero.mobile: The photograph panel takes the top 64svh inside an 8px frame, with the headline at 12vw on two lines in its upper third and the action button at its bottom-centre. The swatch column becomes five full-width bars, each 52px tall with its link at 15px, stacked directly under the panel; the first three show above the fold. The supporting sentence moves into the first section.
hero.headline: A two-line statement of three to five words, up to about 14 characters per line at 8.6vw, set over the sky.

type.note: A tall American gothic taken from city signage, blunt and civic, over a plain public-service sans. Suits culture indexes, community projects, bars, sport clubs and local campaigns.

palette.name: Tobacco and olive
palette.note: Tobacco brown fills the page with bone type, and photographs stay in browns and ochre. One olive block holds the main text or the button, and a single ochre band may break the brown once.

photos.title: Architecture
photos.note: structure, lines, bridges, facades and building interiors
photos.treatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.

motion.name: Colour by chapter
motion.description: Each chapter is its own full-bleed field of one palette colour, so the ground changes exactly at section edges as you scroll, never as a global recolouring of the screen. The only movement: the fixed header (or the one pinned element) takes the ink of the chapter beneath it, switching with a 300ms colour transition as each edge passes under it. Do not drive the page background from an observer: in blind tests a page recoloured mid-section, with a paragraph sitting on two colours, read as broken twice.

sections.name: Wide photo, colour tile, facts
sections.blueprint: Top: a heading of two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px) on the left margin, then 24px below it a three-line lead paragraph at 21–22px across columns 1–6. 72px lower, two tiles sit side by side with a 16px gap. The left tile spans columns 1–8: a landscape photograph at 16:10 with one radius (0 or 10px). A short paragraph of up to 35 words at 16px is set in a solid paper-colour block 320px wide with 20px padding, placed over the photograph's top-right corner and flush with both edges. The right tile spans columns 9–12 and is a flat palette colour, 60% of the photograph's height: it holds a simple inline SVG outline of the region or the floor plan as one filled shape, with one solid dot marking the location. Under the colour tile, four label and value pairs at 14px in a two-by-two grid: altitude, distance, season, local time.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9vw, lead at 18px. The photograph goes full width at 4:3 and its overlaid paragraph moves beneath it as ordinary text. The colour tile follows at full width and 3:2, and the four label and value pairs sit under it in two columns.

sections.name: Rows with margin photographs
sections.blueprint: Everything hangs from one vertical axis at column 5, about 35% of the width. First the heading: a statement of up to five words at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) starting on the axis, vertically centred in an otherwise empty 70svh of ground. Then four or five benefit rows, each starting on the same axis: a title at clamp(28px, 3vw, 48px) and under it a paragraph of 34ch at 17px. Columns 1–4 stay empty. At the right margin each row carries one photograph, top-aligned with its title and deliberately unequal: 240px wide at 4:5 in one row, 320px at 3:2 in the next, 180px square after that. Rows are separated by 96–120px of space, not lines. On a saturated field, set all type in one pale ink and leave the photographs ungraded.
sections.mobile: The axis collapses to the left margin. The statement sits at 9vw in 50svh of empty ground. Each row stacks its title at 26px, the paragraph, then its photograph at alternating widths: 100%, 70% flush right, 55% flush left. 64px between rows.

sections.name: One verb at a time
sections.blueprint: Three to five full-bleed panels, each 100svh tall, stacked with no gap; each is one stage and holds one photograph covering it. In every panel a single word, the verb for that stage ('Cut', 'Fold', 'Stitch', 'Press'), is set at clamp(96px, 17vw, 300px), heavy and centred, inside a wrapper that is position: sticky; top: 50% and shifted up by half its own height. Because each word is sticky only within its own panel, it holds the centre of the screen while its photograph passes behind it, and is then pushed out by the next panel's verb. Use mix-blend-mode: difference in white, or one solid colour tested on every image. One sentence at 18px sits in the bottom-left corner of each panel over a neutral scrim limited to that corner. There is no separate heading: the verbs, read in order, are both the heading and the sequence.
sections.mobile: Panels stay 100svh, each photograph cropped to a vertical slice. The verb is 24vw, still sticky at the centre. The sentence sits along the bottom over a scrim at 16px, full width with 16px margins.

sections.name: Photographs gathered round a heading
sections.blueprint: A band about one screen tall on the plain page ground, used as the page's one deliberate rest. At its visual centre sits the heading, two lines at clamp(32px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light weight, centred, with one sentence at 17px under it and a text link beneath that. Around it six to eight small photographs are scattered irregularly across the middle columns (x 320–1120; the outer 320px on each side stay empty, equally), each 160–200px wide at about 9:10, square corners, at different heights with 60–200px of air between them. Two of them come within 40px of the heading's block, which their drift never reaches, so the cluster reads as gathered round it rather than laid on a grid. No captions and no frames. Each photograph drifts at its own rate as the band passes (4–12% of its own height on a scroll-linked timeline), so the cluster loosens and tightens; under reduced motion it stays put. The pictures come from one place or one day and share one treatment.
sections.mobile: Five photographs at 30% of the width sit offset left and right around the centred heading, two above it and three below, none cut by an edge. The heading drops to 7vw on two lines.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

references.name: IZANAMI
references.idea: Silence as design: one small sentence in fog, then a slow descent from mist into a dark glass pavilion.
references.hero: After a warm-black loader showing only one 18px serif sentence and a small counter, the hero is a full-bleed, desaturated grey-green image of pine forest dissolving into fog. The same sentence stays at 18px in white, left-aligned on a line about 17% from the left edge and exactly at vertical centre; it is the only text in the picture area. A small white seal-style logo sits top-left; a language switch and menu label in tiny tracked capitals sit top-right, each with a dot above. Along the bottom edge: copyright, two live city clocks, and a scroll cue at far right, all near 10px.
references.type: Playfair Display regular for the few headings, only 18 to 45px (3.1vw at most); Shippori Mincho for body at 14px; Cinzel capitals with wide tracking for nav, clocks and footer. Nothing is large: hierarchy comes from isolation rather than size.
references.colour: #0a0801 #6f7a70 #b7b5a6 #d9d2c3 #4b5b39 — Warm near-black panels and grey-green fog imagery with off-white text at reduced opacity. Moss green and sand from the small garden photos are the only colour; there is no accent.
references.imagery: Fog-bound forest, a black-framed glass pavilion seen in one-point perspective, and small crops of incense smoke, a bamboo water spout and raked gravel. Small images are square-cornered, portrait or square, overlapping one another and the dark ceiling plane.
references.layout: Wide margins, with text hung on an inner line about 17% across instead of the page edge. Most screens hold one image and one short text; small photos are placed asymmetrically near corners and overlap. A rotated section label runs down the left edge.

sections.description: Over the black ceiling of the pavilion image, a three-line serif heading at about 3vw sits left of centre, each line indented further than the one above. Faint body text follows below it. A small square photo sits top-left under the logo; at right, three portrait photos overlap in a cluster, two beige garden shots behind and a narrower green water-ripple image in front and raised higher, running off the bottom edge.

Full-bleed one-point-perspective view down a glass corridor, its ceiling filling the upper half as near-black. A text link with a short leading rule sits top-left on the inner line; a landscape photo of raked gravel is tucked against the top edge right of centre; a three-line heading fades in low and left of centre over the glass. A section name rotated ninety degrees runs down the far left.

Near-black and almost empty. One section name in serif at about 24px, preceded by a long thin rule, sits at mid-height left of centre. Lower down, tiny tracked-capital columns: a nav list, two office addresses side by side, and social links pushed to the far right. The bottom edge repeats the copyright and the two city clocks.

steal: Place a single 18px sentence at vertical centre on an offset left line over full-bleed fog, and let the absence of a headline be the statement.
Stair-step a three-line heading by indenting each line further than the one above it.
Run two live city clocks with time-zone labels along the bottom edge as quiet proof of where the firm operates.
references.media: A misted forest photograph covers the whole first screen under drifting cloud layers, with text on about 0.2% of the area. Then a pinned full-screen architectural scene dollies forward while overlapping collages of two or three photographs at different widths pass over it, rows pair a text column at about 28vw with a portrait flush to the right margin, and the fog band returns as a bookend; about 11 photographs, one WebGL canvas, no video.
references.motion: A warm near-black screen with the tagline already in place until about 2.5s, then a fog bank creeps in from the lower right and the chrome fades in by 4.5s; load took 7.2s. Lenis with three sticky sections scrubs the scene as the forest darkens and the camera sinks into the pavilion, photographs move at different rates, and headline lines fade in one by one; two cloud layers loop on 100s linear translates, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

references.name: White Desert
references.idea: One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.
references.hero: Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.
references.type: Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.
references.colour: #040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.
references.imagery: Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.
references.layout: A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.

sections.description: A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.

Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.

A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.

Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.

steal: Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.
Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.
Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.
references.media: An 18s muted aerial and ice-cave clip covers the whole first screen under a scrim, with the title docked along the bottom edge. Later pictures dissolve into the white page through fog-like fades, a horizontal accordion opens one trip panel at half width beside blurred slivers, vertical ice strips wipe across the previous photograph, and a long pinned track of inset cards floats on a full-bleed texture ground before a closing photo panel carrying a quotation; 20 images, one video, square corners and a high-key cold grade.
references.motion: There is no entrance choreography and footage plays from the first frame; under Lenis the hero title blurs and is swallowed by a sticky fog layer growing from 390 to 900px tall, statement lines fill from grey to navy, the camps heading scrubs from 140px down to 60px, and a pinned horizontal track moves the cards at about 0.56px per scrolled pixel over an 8,328px runway. Blocks rise 20rem with opacity over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and hovers run .3s cubic-bezier(.5,1,.89,1).

references.name: LPAS
references.idea: An architecture and interiors practice organised by market sector: each of five sectors gets its own earthy ground colour, like swatches from a material board, and the sectors slide as a card rail over a fixed, dimmed video of the studio; a 45-degree corner cut taken from the logo is the one shape motif.
references.hero: After a charcoal loader of about 4.5s with four stacked process verbs, a full-bleed muted studio video at half brightness fills the screen. A thin wordmark top-left at 50px, a small dark menu pill top-right. The headline, 75px (5.2vw, leading 1.0) in three lines about 800px wide, is docked bottom-left with its last baseline about 65px above the bottom edge, and three 14px labels (discipline, approach, a scroll cue with a 30px circle arrow) sit exactly on the vertical centre line. A 200px sliver of the first sector card already shows at the right edge as the cue to continue. The headline arrives last, about 5s in.
references.type: Aeonik alone, almost entirely at 400 with 600 for small labels, sentence case throughout. A short scale: 75px display (5.2vw, leading 1.0), 56px for the credo and rail titles (3.9vw, leading 1.1), 50px for the closing list, 38 and 28px section titles, 16 and 14px body, 12px captions. Fluid sizes by clamp() on a 10px root.
references.colour: #ffffff #262626 #111111 #625653 #925434 #c9d3df #707569 #e3c1aa — White page, charcoal for the loader and footer, near-black text (though 65% of the characters are set in mid-grey #747474). Five sector grounds of similar value and low chroma (taupe, rust, pale blue-grey, sage, peach), each with a lighter tint for hover; no other accent.
references.imagery: Bright architectural photography with blue skies and dusk light, its brick and timber tones echoing the sector palette, and a 61s documentary-feeling studio video as the hero. Square corners, one 8:5 ratio for projects, no filters; the hero and the closing photo are dimmed to about 50% for white text, and pictures are oversized in their frames so they can drift.
references.layout: 50px margins and a 1340px measure on a 20-column main grid with 10px gutters. A fixed hero overtaken by a pinned horizontal rail (about 4320px of scroll), then a statement, a mirrored mosaic, a news list, a full-bleed photo band and a sticky footer uncovered like a curtain. Section gaps of about 100-140px. The ground changes by section: white, each sector colour, white, charcoal.

sections.description: Five sector cards, each about 770px wide (53.5vw), slide left over the dimmed hero: a photograph on the top 68% and a flat sector-colour panel on the bottom 32%, holding the sector name at 56px bottom-left with a 30px inset, a two-line 16px descriptor right-aligned and a 45px outline circle-plus button top-right. The incoming card's photo grows from about 450 to 615px tall as it centres; neighbours peek about 270px on the left and 400px on the right.
A three-line 56px credo about 647px wide at the top-left; below it a 14px label in a narrow left column and a 16px paragraph about 800px wide starting at x=388, closed by an underlined text link.

Six 8:5 images in two mirrored rows: one large (about 678x424, 47% of the width) beside two small ones (334x209), then two small ones bottom-aligned on the left under a placed void, with the large one on the right. The first large image has its top-left corner cut at 45 degrees by 60px and the last its bottom-right, so the cuts bracket the group. Each image carries a 16px name and a 12px place beneath it.

A full-bleed dimmed interior photograph carrying the five sector names stacked at 50px in white scrolls away to uncover a sticky 625px charcoal footer with two office addresses, social links and a back-to-top link.

steal: Give each content category its own flat ground drawn from one material family at similar value and low chroma, each with a lighter tint for hover, and keep the rest of the page white plus one charcoal, so the colours read as a system and not as decoration.

Take one shape from the logo and use it sparingly: a 45-degree corner cut of 20-60px on a single corner of selected images, alternating top-left on the first and bottom-right on the last so the cuts bracket a group.

Stagger a two-row mosaic big-small-small, then small-small-big, with the small pair bottom-aligned to the tall neighbour so the void above them is placed; keep one ratio and caption every image in 16px. The site's 75px hero headline runs to three lines; under the house rules cut it to two.
references.media: A 61s muted studio video at 50% brightness covers the whole first screen and stays fixed while a rail of photo-over-colour cards slides over it; projects sit in a mirrored 8:5 mosaic, and a full-bleed dimmed photo band carries the closing list. Thirteen media elements in all, no canvas or WebGL.
references.motion: Under Lenis the sector rail pins for about 4320px and travels about 836px per 900px of wheel while the incoming photo grows and pictures drift inside oversized frames. Project images wipe in with clip-path inset and opacity over 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.14,0.83,0.4,1), hovers take .3s cubic-bezier(0,0,.13,.99), the headline rises through a mask after the 4.5s loader, and there is no reduced-motion rule.
